steps: Share the CBT Refer-A-Friend referral form with a friend.
Friend opens a new CBT checking account and keeps it open 30+ days with a positive balance.
Complete the qualifying activity within 6 months.
You receive a $50 credit into your CBT checking account within 30 calendar days - unlimited referrals.
timing: $50 credit within 30 calendar days of the qualifying activity.
when_cash_arrives: $50 credit within 30 calendar days of the qualifying activity. Paid after your friend completes the program's activity requirements - the friend's qualification is the gating step.
maximize: Have your friend knock out transaction counts in a single day (small purchases) and set up direct deposit on the first paycheck - do not let activity dribble across the window.
Verify the exact qualification checklist with the institution before referring - thin-terms programs often have unpublished requirements that void referrals.
Structural reason it cannot be faster: you only get paid if the friend completes real banking activity; a join-and-idle referral earns nothing.
